rca_of_the_issue: The client-side normalizer was added, but AdminSettings normalizes the UI field prematurely: onChange strips formatting and slices to 10 digits, and sendTestSms/dryRunSms only allow /^\d{10}$/. Thus non-10-digit-but-valid Indian phone formats never reach toIndianE164 intact. The user's exact 10-digit dry-run symptom is fixed, but the requested broader mobile formatting is partial.
